M01.criterion_in_master: Fix domain, policies, quantifiers, distribution or worst case, thresholds and F/U regions; allow empty regions. **DONE — scope formulation**, [result](./M01_SCOPE_AND_QUANTIFIERS.md).

M02.criterion_in_master: Construct difficult worlds and viable control with ground truth, observations, optimum and mixtures; rule out a sufficient common shortcut. **DONE — construction and controls**, [result](./M02_WORLDS_AND_CONTROLS.md).

M03.criterion_in_master: Derive necessary information and resources, covering adaptation, randomness, memory, certificates and collaboration of the asserted class. **IN_PROGRESS — existing F/W derivation; closure of the expanded objective pending**, [Universal proofs, frontiers and technologies](./M03_M04_TRILEMMA_THEOREMS.md).
M03.reopening_reason: expanded final objective; prior conditional F/W derivations retained, no counterexample asserted

M04.criterion_in_master: Prove or reject a region through inequalities, frontiers and a nonemptiness witness; retain the failed attempt. **IN_PROGRESS — existing F/W derivation; closure of the expanded objective pending**, [Universal proofs, frontiers and technologies](./M03_M04_TRILEMMA_THEOREMS.md).
M04.reopening_reason: expanded final objective; prior conditional F/W derivations retained, no counterexample asserted

M05.criterion_in_master: Check witnesses against C02–C05 and map assumptions; finite enumeration covers its declared domain.

M06.criterion_in_master: Verify sources and attack the proof with counterexamples; start targeted search early and complete the argument audit. **IN_PROGRESS — source intake**, [record](./M06_PRIMARY_SOURCE_INTAKE.md).

M07.criterion_in_master: Review correspondence with R01, 00M/00N, E1–E7 and extensions; separate scenario, technology and historical incident.

M08.criterion_in_master: Review clarity and visuals; distinguish proved, measured and unresolved regions, with axes and units.

M09.criterion_in_master: Preserve content, links and frozen versions; close the mathematical deliverable with evidence and limits.

M10.criterion_in_master: Unify success/risk, observation and quantifiers before M03; do not confuse empirical failure with universal impossibility. **DONE — contract reconciliation**, [result](./M10_P03_CONTRACT_AND_MEASUREMENT_AUDIT.md).

M11.criterion_in_master: Attack frontiers, degenerate cases, priors, certificates and controls; check sensitivity and constructive upper bounds when they exist. **IN_PROGRESS — cost and prior controls**, [record](./M10_P03_CONTRACT_AND_MEASUREMENT_AUDIT.md).

M12.criterion_in_master: Target-theorem contract and obligation mapping. **OPEN**; full criteria and dependencies in the current plan above.
M12.new_acceptance: Versioned contract of independent parameters theta=(L,n,N,geometry,interface,prior,costs,prior data,thresholds), policies and results C/eta/rho/sigma. Separate AVG/WC, per-trace/expected budget and work/latency. Fix technology→family→size→policy quantifiers and the three pairwise controls, viable and infeasible families. Inventory of claims with hypotheses, lemma, construction and required review; separate minimum thesis from expansions. Do not infer hardness from L, N or distance alone.

M13.criterion_in_master: Theorems on technology classes and complete cost. **OPEN**; full criteria and dependencies in the current plan above.
M13.new_acceptance: Classify coordinate interfaces, global predicates/certificates and executors/barriers; define observable simulation and charges justifying inheritance of a bound. For each class: hypotheses, producer/use cost, lower bound, upper control or open limit, kernel change and absolute/relative elimination or elimination of risk only. Compare f(n(L))/C0(L); retain worsening cases. A commercial name, positive cost or output size establishes neither membership nor persistence.

M14.criterion_in_master: Robustness with partial information, noise and amortization. **OPEN**; full criteria and dependencies in the current plan above.
M14.new_acceptance: Fix separate profiles for partial/noisy/stale certificates, initial information, cache and preparation costs allocated across episodes. Retain error laws, freshness, correlation and total charge. Derive bounds and controls where generalization is claimed; in other profiles record OUT_OF_SCOPE or UNRESOLVED. Distinguish new data from reuse and per-execution budget from expected budget; W5 is not announced as an exact frontier.

M15.criterion_in_master: Distributed and geometric extension: work and latency. **OPEN**; full criteria and dependencies in the current plan above.
M15.new_acceptance: Define network of N agents, fact locations, distances/topology, message capacity and price, queues and deadline. Retain centralized envelope for aggregate work. For any new temporal claim, derive a communication/critical-path bound and a realizable control, charging duplication and maintenance. Identify regions where parallelism/proximity resolve the deadline and where they do not. Do not extrapolate work bounds to time or geometry.

M16.criterion_in_master: Independent symbolic review of the proof. **OPEN**; full criteria and dependencies in the current plan above.
M16.new_acceptance: Reviewer distinct from the author and not fictitiously assigned: reconstruct F1–F4, W1–W5, G1, T1/T2 and quantifiers, covering omitted policies, normalization, budget in failed branches, abstention, equality and known controls. Verdict per claim: VALIDATED_IN_SCOPE, COUNTEREXAMPLE or GAP; M13–M15 reviewed separately if included. Executing the author's script does not suffice. Consider formalizing critical lemmas if it adds coverage; an incomplete attempt is not formal proof. Self-review may continue without closing this task.
M16.reviewer_requirement: distinct from author; UNASSIGNED, no independent review claimed

M17.criterion_in_master: Mathematical bridge between the families and R01. **OPEN**; full criteria and dependencies in the current plan above.
M17.new_acceptance: Choose an explicit objective: supplemental family or R01 subfamily. To assert the latter, construct embedding/reduction of worlds, actions, observations, effects and costs; map ALL relevant R01 policies into the covered class, including connectors, geometry, authority, queries and barriers. Check reduction direction: exhibiting a policy or preserving selected traces does not suffice to transfer impossibility. Limit the result to a submodel or mark GAP if R01 supplies additional information or actions. E1–E7 and M07 consistency do not replace the reduction.

C01.criterion_in_master: Inventory and reproduce existing code; identify reuse, constraints and fingerprints without renaming controls as R01 campaigns.

C02.criterion_in_master: Fix schemas, encoding, operations, costs, observations and horizon/termination; declare any narrower submodel.

C03.criterion_in_master: Implement an independent generator and exact reference; check M/I/P, ties, connectors, mixtures and world rejections.

C04.criterion_in_master: Implement execution, recorder, costs and evaluation of effects, quality, success, violations, incompleteness and times.

C05.criterion_in_master: Check small worlds and invalid traces; attack stale evidence, duplication, permissions and oracle leakage.

C06.criterion_in_master: Deliver a reproducible traversal with command, environment, policies, seeds and traces; improvement, rejection and incompleteness without forced failures.

C07.criterion_in_master: Measure time/memory under registered limits; retain timeouts and distinguish evaluator cost from operational cost.

C08.criterion_in_master: Audit numerical precision, randomness, competence and termination; resolve or record corpus discrepancies.

C09.criterion_in_master: Verify another bot understands installation, execution, outputs and failures; review visuals when they clarify limits.

C10.criterion_in_master: Freeze successor and review diff, links, fingerprints and preservation for each deliverable's scope.

C11.criterion_in_master: Register resources, precision, samples, contrasts, units, grouping, multiplicity, censoring, errors and stopping rules before execution.

C12.criterion_in_master: Execute base campaign and paired analysis: q/e/a/f/C/t/K, uncertainty, ablations and regions for evaluated policies.

C13.criterion_in_master: Audit accidental clues, tuning/memory, comparators and randomness streams; complete control before the campaign.

C14.criterion_in_master: Implement and evaluate architecture selector with pilots and separate sets; compare simple rules and retain indeterminacy.

P01.criterion_in_master: Deepen primary sources and freeze locators; claim–source matrix and search limits.

P02.criterion_in_master: Try to obtain the same value with existing methods and simple alternatives; falsify each surviving contribution.

P03.criterion_in_master: Audit measures and boundary cases; retain costs without delivery, indeterminacy and constraints without reward compensation. **DONE — measurement audit**, [result](./M10_P03_CONTRACT_AND_MEASUREMENT_AUDIT.md).

P04.criterion_in_master: Review C oracle contract and evidence; do not create duplicate work under another name.

P05.criterion_in_master: Verify requirements, terminology, authority, versions and transfer limits against the current corpus.

P06.criterion_in_master: Check readability for research and architecture decisions without losing technical distinctions.

P07.criterion_in_master: Evaluate visual aids; every conceptual figure is identified and no invented frontier is presented as measured.

P08.criterion_in_master: Diagnose integrity initially and repair with an explicit successor; retain history and verify navigation/content.

P09.criterion_in_master: Audit deliverable value and strongest claim; record limits and distinguish self-review from independent review.

P10.criterion_in_master: Define decision, alternatives, falsifiable incremental value and investment ceiling; gates for continuing, narrowing, reformulating or stopping. **IN_PROGRESS — initial decision to continue/narrow**, [record](./M10_P03_CONTRACT_AND_MEASUREMENT_AUDIT.md).

P11.criterion_in_master: Design selection study before C14: eligible information, independent reference, error, cost and partitions.

P12.criterion_in_master: Check improvement in decisions or effort and scale limits; a correct oracle does not prove prospective pilot utility.

T01.criterion_in_master: Fix three configurations of smolagents, LangGraph and OpenAI Agents SDK, versions, models, controls and real access.

T02.criterion_in_master: Map E1–E7, parameters, traces and uncovered operations; admit, restrict or reject correspondences with evidence.

T03.criterion_in_master: Implement adapters and recorder per technology; check replay, duplication, order and unexpected effects.

T04.criterion_in_master: Check permitted, forbidden, blocked, incomplete, late and exhausted fixtures; separate fixture from behavior.

T05.criterion_in_master: Execute registered traversals with model/policy, real traces and independent evaluation; retain errors and abstentions.

T06.criterion_in_master: Issue verdict per technology and measure costs/latencies; justify exact, approximate, rejected or open transfer.

T07.criterion_in_master: Attack admission with native controls, certificates, memory, hidden information and omitted costs; verify fixed APIs.

T08.criterion_in_master: Review consistency and scientific eligibility; infer neither historical causality nor EA advantage.

T09.criterion_in_master: Review readability and visuals of adapter–recorder–oracle traversal and its limits.

T10.criterion_in_master: Preserve all three dispositions, files, results and links; audit each technology deliverable.

T11.criterion_in_master: Qualify all three and prioritize first implementation by observed feasibility and uncertainty; do not presume access or cost.

T12.criterion_in_master: Replicate on separate sets and check sensitivity/versions/scale; do not transport rates between different policies.
